### Summary of Changes

Wired [`derived_translation_fallback`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/scripts/lexicon/derived_en_fallback.py#L81-L115) into [`_translation_for_entry`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/scripts/lexicon/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py#L417-L466) in [`scripts/lexicon/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/scripts/lexicon/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py) immediately after the deadjectival adverb fallback ([#6903](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6903)).

#### Key Implementation Details
1. **Fallback Ordering**:
   - Direct translation (`enrich_manifest._translation`)
   - VESUM base lookup (`enrich_manifest._base_lookup_for_entry`)
   - Deadjectival adverb fallback (`_deadjectival_adverb_translation`)
   - Diminutive / augmentative noun fallback ([`derived_en_fallback.derived_translation_fallback`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/scripts/lexicon/derived_en_fallback.py#L81-L115))
2. **Integration Tests**: Added end-to-end tests in [`tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py#L649-L893) covering:
   - Diminutive noun translation fill (`білочка` from base `білка`)
   - Augmentative noun translation fill (`вовчище` from base `вовк`)
   - Fail-closed behavior when base lacks English gloss or is not a noun
   - Strict fallback priority verification across the translation chain
   - Manifest pair resolution
3. **Verification**:
   - `pytest`: 36/36 tests passing in [`tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py) and [`tests/test_derived_en_fallback.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-wire-diminutive/tests/test_derived_en_fallback.py)
